snippet.title: Lunadra | Grow Giant and Challenge Legendary Monsters! | Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Nintendo Switch Exclusive
Survivor Roguelite RPG
Official Trailer for “Lunadra: Luna Awakens the Legendary Dragon”

Coming July 2, 2026!

Luna, a black cat adventurer,
is granted the power of the legendary ancient dragon, Selva.

Harness the power to grow gigantic
and challenge legendary monsters slumbering across the world.

■ Giant Transformation System
■ Co-op Multiplayer
■ Diverse Builds & Support Cards
■ Epic Battles Against Legendary Monsters

▼ Official Website
https://lunadra.luna-no-shippo.co.jp/en/

#Lunadra #NintendoSwitch #IndieGame #Roguelite #SurvivorLike
